content:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: KV cache prefetch surge in prod (region: us-west-2). Error rate elevated for large-tenant traffic, paging observed on kv-node-3. Alert: kv_cache_prefetch_growth > 90% for 5m :rotating_light:
oncall_jordan: I got the page. looking at dashboards now. assigning to @maria_dev for root cause triage :mag:
maria_dev: seeing a big spike in cache entries tied to `prefetch_kv=true` rollout 2h ago. continuous-batching seems to be prefetching entire request prefixes for some tenant flows (high fanout). memory + paging increases on nodes serving tenant acme-corp.
raj_sre: tagging traces — link: https://observability.redwood/prod/traces?query=prefetch+kv — high nv in kv_puts/sec coincident with batch_window_ms=40ms config.
liam_platform: stack metrics: iowait up, cache_evictions up x6, and kernel paging per node. logs attached from kv-node-3:
```
[2025-03-22T14:12:03Z] kv_put key=tenant:acme-corp:req:xyz size=12kb prefetch=true
[2025-03-22T14:12:03Z] kv_cache_insert ok shard=7 len_before=12 len_after=12000
[2025-03-22T14:12:03Z] mem_available dropping fast, page_faults rising
```
joan_support: acme-corp is reporting slow responses and some 500s. their CS rep says 3% of requests timed out over the last 10m.
alice_prod: root cause hypothesis: prefetching + continuous batching caused an amplification loop — prefetch expands cached prefixes which increases batch key sets which triggers more prefetches. it's a combinatorial blowup for some tenant patterns.
oncall_jordan: immediate mitigation options? per-tenant disable, global kill-switch, reduce batch window, or revert rollout.
maria_dev: recommended immediate mitigation: set per-tenant override to disable prefetch for top impacted tenants (acme-corp, big-retailer) while we do canary for a global flag rollback. Prefer per-tenant first to avoid global perf impact.
liam_platform: I can run tenant toggle now. command I will use: `featureflag-cli set prefetch_kv=false --tenant=acme-corp --actor=liam_platform` then monitor.
deploy-bot: Deploy hooks: recent rollout id=deploy-20250322-prefetch-v2. No infra deploy needed to flip flag.
raj_sre: also create a canary for global rollback at 5%: `featureflag-cli set prefetch_kv=false --percentage=5 --actor=maria_dev` so we can validate system behavior before broader rollback.
liam_platform: executed per-tenant toggle for acme-corp. command output:
```
> featureflag-cli set prefetch_kv=false --tenant=acme-corp --actor=liam_platform
OK: prefetch_kv=false set for tenant=acme-corp (applied: 14:15:02Z)
```
liam_platform: monitoring metrics now — eviction rate for acme-corp dropping, io wait decreasing on kv-node-3. initial latency for acme-corp requests down ~40% in last 60s. :white_check_mark:
maria_dev: starting 5% canary rollback as discussed. will watch for any regressions in throughput patterns.
alice_prod: preparing a small hotfix to batcher: reduce `batch_window_ms` from 40 -> 10 and add a safety cap to max_batch_keys to prevent combinatorial growth. build & test ok in staging. will wait for green from canary before doing rollout.
joan_support: notifying acme-corp support channel: "We've applied a per-tenant mitigation disabling prefetch for your traffic and are monitoring. Please let us know if you still see issues"
maria_dev: canary started (5%). early signal: global cache growth curve is flattening, page faults trending down. logs show fewer prefetch events per request.
raj_sre: action items so far:
- liam_platform: per-tenant disable applied to acme-corp and big-retailer (done for acme, queued for big-retailer)
- maria_dev: 5% global canary rollback in progress
- alice_prod: batcher hotfix ready to deploy once canary stable
- joan_support: customer communications live

oncall_jordan: timeline and owner for full rollback or hotfix rollout?
maria_dev: give canary 10m. if page faults keep falling and latency stable, proceed to 50% then 100% rollback of prefetch (or switch to new safe prefetch mode). alice deploys batcher hotfix as follow-up to reduce recurrence risk.
liam_platform: applying tenant toggle for big-retailer now. output: OK applied 14:18:40Z. monitoring.
alice_prod: starting canary deploy of batcher hotfix to one cluster (cluster-id=cluster-batch-canary-1). will roll if no regressions in 15m. deploy command (ops):
```
kubectl set image deployment/batcher batcher=registry/redwood/batcher:20250322-hotfix
```
deploy-bot: CI checks passed, canary deploy initiated. link: https://ci.redwood/builds/67890

maria_dev: canary telemetry (7m): global page_fault_rate -25%, kv_cache_entries growth rate normalized. no spike in errors.
joan_support: acme-corp CS updated: reports latency improved to normal for the last 6m.
oncall_jordan: good. next steps: finish canary rollback to 50% then 100% over phoned schedule, deploy batcher hotfix to all clusters, and follow up with a postmortem. please capture exact featureflag changes and tenant list.
raj_sre: drafting a short incident summary in #incidents and will start a runbook for preventing prefetch amplification (add max_prefetch_keys, tenant-traffic heuristics).
alice_prod: canary batcher deploy healthy after 12m. preparing full rollout in 5m. command for full rollout uses rolling update.
liam_platform: monitoring infra side, autoscaling held steady after per-tenant mitigations, no further paging.
maria_dev: rolling rollback of prefetch_kv to false at 50% -> now at 50% (applied 14:34:10Z). metrics continue to look stable.
oncall_jordan: I'm handing off to night on-call @raj_sre at 14:40Z. please take over monitoring and postmortem ownership. we should flag tenants with similar traffic patterns for immediate review. :handshake:
raj_sre: ack, I'll take it. creating an incident ticket and assigning postmortem. checklist: capture timeline, flag toggles, command outputs, canary metrics, and proposed mitigations (prefetch caps, batcher safe defaults).
joan_support: will follow up with customer update email template and coordinate support wrap-up.
maria_dev: quick notes for postmortem: root cause = prefetch_kv unbounded in combination with continuous batch expansion for certain request patterns; mitigations = per-tenant disable, global rollback, batcher hotfix (reduce batch_window_ms + max_batch_keys cap). follow-ups: add prefetch safety caps, add tenant-level preview in staging, and implement alert for exponential cache growth per-tenant.
oncall_jordan: closing live mitigation. If anything new pops, ping pager. thanks everyone for fast response. :rocket:
incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "mitigated" state at 14:41:30Z.
